name: Norflurazepam
summary: Benzodiazepine analogue that is an active metabolite to many other benzodiazepines, such as flurazepam, flutoprazepam, and midazolam.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet

pharmacology.text: N-Desalkylflurazepam (also known as norflurazepam) is a benzodiazepine analog and an active metabolite of several other benzodiazepine drugs including flurazepam, flutoprazepam, fludiazepam, midazolam, flutazolam, quazepam, and ethyl loflazepate. It is long-acting, prone to accumulation, and binds unselectively to the various benzodiazepine receptor subtypes.

uses.text: It has been sold as a designer drug from 2016 onward.

summaryZh: N-去烷基氟西泮又稱去甲氟西泮是一種苯二氮卓類藥物的類似物，亦是包括氟西泮、氟托西泮、氟地西泮、咪達唑侖、氟他唑侖、夸西泮與氯氟卓乙酯在內的若干其他苯二氮卓類藥物的活性代謝產物。其作用時間長，易於蓄積，且會與苯二氮卓受體的各種不同亞型進行非選擇性結合。從 2016 年起其便作為策劃藥出售。

sideEffects.en: Benzodiazepines cause drowsiness, poor coordination, slurred speech and memory gaps. Regular use leads to tolerance and dependence, and stopping suddenly after heavy use can cause seizures, which can be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 苯二氮平類會造成嗜睡、協調變差、口齒不清與記憶斷片。規律使用會產生耐受性與依賴，大量使用後突然停藥可能引發癲癇發作，甚至有生命危險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 苯二氮平类会造成嗜睡、协调制差、口齿不清与记忆断片。规律使用会产生耐受性与依赖，大量使用后突然停药可能引发癫痫发作，甚至有生命危险。

fact.en: It is a crossroads of benzodiazepine chemistry, being an active breakdown product of flurazepam, flutoprazepam, midazolam and several others.
fact.zh: 它是苯二氮平化學的交會點，是氟西泮、氟托拉西泮、咪達唑侖等多種藥物的活性分解產物。
fact.zhHans: 它是苯二氮平化学的交会点，是氟西泮、氟托拉西泮、咪达唑仑等多种药物的活性分解产物。
